description: A preferred-citation block (CITATION.cff preferred-citation) or README bibtex points to a journal article, so authors, title, DOI, and year diverge between the citation surfaces and the software's own record.
representative_note: cff and doi_record points to Journal paper
in_checkout_projection: CITATION.cff gains a preferred-citation to a journal article whose authors/title/DOI/year differ from the cff main block; README citation section carries the same journal bibtex.

description: Version differs between metadata surfaces (archive record vs. registry listing in the log; stale surface lags the released version).
representative_note: cff has preferred citation pointing to an article
in_checkout_projection: CITATION.cff version differs from pyproject.toml version (registry metadata is generated from pyproject, so this projects the doi_record/pypi version conflicts onto in-checkout surfaces).

description: Registry surface carries a short package name while other surfaces carry the full or versioned title.
representative_note: cff and doi has same name with version difference. Pypi has a short name with same vversion of cff
in_checkout_projection: pyproject.toml name/description carries the short name while CITATION.cff title and README heading carry the full title.

description: Author entity type diverges across surfaces: a team or corporate name on one surface versus an individual list or a different corporate entity on another.
representative_note: "The CUDA-Q development team" for doi and cff while "NVIDIA Corporation & Affiliates" for pypi
in_checkout_projection: CITATION.cff authors list individuals while pyproject.toml authors carry a team/corporate entity (or vice versa).

description: Concept DOI and versioned DOI are mixed across surfaces, so the DOI field disagrees depending on which surface is read.
representative_note: cff doi is for archive of all versions. Doi_crecords for current version
in_checkout_projection: CITATION.cff doi carries the versioned DOI while the README badge and codemeta.json identifier carry the concept DOI.

description: Author names encoded differently across surfaces (LaTeX-escaped accents in README bibtex versus Unicode elsewhere), breaking exact matching.
representative_note: LaTeX-escaped accent (Hern'andez vs Hernández) blocked one name match
in_checkout_projection: README bibtex spells one author with LaTeX-escaped accents while CITATION.cff spells the same author in Unicode.

description: License field differs between metadata surfaces.
representative_note: doi_record points to arXibv paper while cff has this as preferred ciatation and readme has it in bibtex
in_checkout_projection: CITATION.cff license differs from pyproject.toml license/LICENSE file.
